summary: Flathead County L-4 lookout built 1938 and abandoned 1954, later removed; one source gives an R-1 cab, and no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1954 per firelookout.com; Forest Lookouts says removed, with no date given

evidence.supports: Crow's nest two miles east, still there
Tree crow's nest with tent camp at the site
evidence.quote: A tree crow's nest with tent camp.

evidence.supports: Round native timber tower with an R-1 cab (conflicting description)
evidence.quote: A round native timber tower with a R-1 cab.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com and one Forest Lookouts page say L-4; a second Forest Lookouts page says a round native timber tower with an R-1 cab. The story follows the L-4 majority and flags the R-1 description.
Abandoned in 1954 (firelookout.com) and removed (Forest Lookouts, undated) are compatible; the removal date is unknown.

notes_for_editor: The Bruce Ridge page that was listed as source 4 is a different lookout (4 miles WSW of Spotted Bear R.S.) and has been removed from this record. Elevation 5,928 ft is about 1,807 m. It is unclear whether the crow's nest two miles east (firelookout.com) is the same tree crow's nest that Forest Lookouts describes at the site. Two 2026 Flathead timber notices (Whitefish Pilot, Daily Interlake) mention units along Reid Divide about 10 miles west of Whitefish; they were seen only as search snippets, do not describe the lookout, and were not used.
